proposal_for: FR-0012 / PR-0008 AC-7 (second half) -- how a Decision item SAYS it demands build work, so a validator line can name a decision nobody derived an item from
title: Eine Entscheidung, die Bauarbeit verlangt, sagt das in einem Feld -- und der Validator nennt jede geltende Entscheidung, auf die kein Item zeigt
context: FR-0012 (user verdict 2026-09-02: JA, BAUEN, as a verifier duty, no new scaffold). MEASURED CASE: DEC-0034 (model escalation ladder, 2026-08-10) stood VALID for 26 days while nothing built it and no item pointed at it; the lead answered the model question from model_tiers.yaml and left the decision out until the user asked (CLAUDE.md, 2026-08-17; DEC-0080 records it). MEASURED TODAY (b7f282e, this store): `validate` has no line about a DEC at all except the supersedes shape; a DEC has no automaton, no parent binding and no field that says whether it commits anyone to work. Three ways a decision could say so, each with its cost: (A) A FIELD on DEC -- `work: none | [item ids]` -- required at capture from the day it lands, OPTIONAL for the ~80 decisions the store already holds (a required field on a stored type turns every existing DEC into a validator error no command repairs; the same argument DEC-0061 measured for EVD). The validator names a DEC in force whose `work` names an item that does not exist, or whose `work` is absent AND no item in the store points at the DEC (see C). Cost: one more field a lead types; a lead who writes `work: none` on a decision that does demand work is caught by nobody -- the same human half FR-0007 names. (B) A PHRASE CLASS over `decision`/`consequences` (modal verbs, 'wird gebaut', 'built in', a number plus a threshold word). REJECTED before it is proposed: a heuristic over prose is the house rule's forbidden shape (FR-0010, FR-0012's own text), and the two measured cases were caught by a human, not by a word. (C) THE POINTER DIRECTION alone -- a DEC in force is 'carried' when some item (any type, active or archived) names its id in any field; one nobody names is reported. Cost: derivable today with no new field and no migration (the id-citation shape `test_review_procedure._item_citations` reads, `state.exists_anywhere`), but it has NO silence for a decision that legitimately demands nothing (a naming rule, a verdict) -- every such DEC would carry the line for ever, which is how a validator stops being read (`report.delivery_closure_rollup`'s own argument).

options.A: field `work` on DEC (optional for stored items, required for new captures): `none` or a list of item ids the kernel resolves like every other binding (`state._assert_origins_resolve`); validator: (1) `work` names an id no item carries -> error; (2) DEC in force, `work` absent, and NO item anywhere names the DEC -> warning 'decision without a carrier'; a DEC with `work: none` is silent
options.B: phrase class over the prose -- REJECTED (house rule: no heuristic over prose; FR-0010)
options.C: pointer direction only, no field: every DEC in force that no item names is a warning; no way to silence a decision that demands nothing

recommendation: A, with C as its detector: the FIELD is the explicit answer and the only honest silence, the POINTER DIRECTION is what catches the decision whose author forgot the field -- the DEC-0034 case is caught by both halves (no `work`, no item naming it for 26 days). Built red-first in kernel/report.py (validator line) + kernel/backlog_types.py (OPTIONAL_FIELDS['DEC'] gains the field) + the capture surface; shipped to the three kits by being kernel code; the lead skills say the field in the DEC step. What stays human and is said so in the text: a `work: none` on a decision that does demand work.
what_the_user_decides: A (field + pointer detector), C (pointer only), or neither (leave FR-0012 as a verifier duty in prose, as the 2026-09-02 verdict literally said -- then the stream writes the duty into harness-verifier.md and builds no validator line)
waiting: the stream builds AC-1..AC-6 and the first half of AC-7 meanwhile; the catcher is built in the same round once this is answered
